profile.name: Hazmi Badrunsham
profile.tagline: I build software, solve problems, and occasionally make things just because I want to see if I can.

paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science student with hands-on experience in application support and software development.
I've worked with SQL, .NET, JavaScript, reporting systems, and web applications, while also building my own projects outside of work.
I enjoy understanding how systems work, fixing things when they don't, and building small ideas into something usable.

points: Develop and maintain SQL-based business reports.
Investigate application issues and data inconsistencies.
Work with insurance, accounting, CRM and reporting modules.
Perform testing and troubleshooting for application defects.
Provide technical support and investigate root causes.
Resolved application issues across web and mobile modules.
Created and maintained business reports using SQL and REPX.
Investigated data issues and performed basic root-cause analysis.
Tested application fixes and maintained GitLab work items.
Worked with application support and development teams.
